create_data_input: create a multiprocessing data input loader with shared memory buffers and worker pools for image batches
transform_image: transform an image with scaling, cropping, and normalization for training or testing splits
preprocess_image: preprocess an image with color jitter, lighting augmentation, and mean or std normalization
convert_to_batch: convert a list of image arrays into a contiguous numpy batch array for model input
fix_bad_image: fix a malformed image by converting grayscale to RGB or trimming extra channels to three
